about.heading: Turning ideas into refined web experiences
paragraphs:
I’m a self-taught developer at the beginning of my programming journey, focused on learning front-end development and building real projects. I enjoy turning ideas into clean, responsive web experiences while continuously learning new technologies and improving my skills.
Currently, I’m learning and building with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Python, Git, and GitHub, while exploring full-stack development with Next.js, Node.js, Express, SQL, and Supabase. I learn through hands-on projects, using each one as an opportunity to experiment, solve problems, and grow as a developer.
